review.rationale: Lane B patch consists entirely of new governance, recommendation, decision, review, and result records documenting the CE-G11B Phase A failure, Phase A-R1 revalidation, Draft PR creation, and independent PR review. All records explicitly preserve the historical Phase A failure without retroactive authorization, enforce strict request caps, maintain read-only boundaries, prohibit workflow execution, Phase B, deployment, and commercial claims, and correctly separate Recommendation/Decision/Result stages. SHA references, timestamps, and model identities are internally consistent. No lineage breaks, overwritten failure truth, request-cap violations, or agent-readability defects were found.
